about.title: About Battle Pack 3: Monster League
paragraphs: Battle Pack 3: Monster League is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG pack released on 31 July 2014, in the ZEXAL era. It has 237 cards, and with the 220 other rarities there are 457 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 237 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 457, adding the 220 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
